description: Hearts. is the best Hearts card game on Windows 8!  Playable by anyone, enjoy hours of entertainment.  Avoid the hearts and queen of spades - take tricks, go for the lowest score.  Great music, 4 difficulty levels for AI, and more.  Perfect for beginners and experts alike.  If you are a fan of Solitaire, UNO, Poker, Card Ace, Blackjack, Casino, Candy Crush, Slot machine, or dice games, you'll love this.  Good luck!
